Please check it before you post it:
- Your photo is 1024×384, and the shoe is about 510px wide. A centred square crop would cut the toe or the heel, so the picture had to be extended above and below.
- Magic Hour has no plain crop-and-pad tool. I used its AI image editor (flux-2-klein, the free model, 5 credits). I asked it to centre the whole shoe, keep the shoe exactly the same, and only extend the floor and room behind it. It also had to fill the empty grey strip on the right of your photo.
- The editor redraws the whole image, so small details on the shoe (stitching, laces, sole texture) may have changed slightly. I couldn't preview the output from here, so compare it with your original.

If you need the shoe pixel-perfect, do it in any photo editor: crop x 0–640 (the photo part, without the grey strip), then add 128px of padding above and below in the floor/wall colour. That gives you a 640×640 image with nothing redrawn. Or tell me what to change and I'll try another version.
